fields.options: DPDP Master — Defines a purpose for which the organisation collects employee personal data. Per Sec 5 DPDP Act 2023, a Data Principal must be notified of the purpose before/at collection. Notice template is rendered to the employee when consent is captured.

fields.label: Purpose Code
fields.description: Short stable identifier, ALL_CAPS_SNAKE_CASE. Used as autoname and in code references. Examples: STATUTORY_PAYROLL, BACKGROUND_CHECK.

fields.label: Lawful Basis
fields.options:
Consent
Statutory Obligation
Legitimate Interest
Contract Performance
Vital Interest
fields.description: DPDP Act recognised lawful bases (Sec 6 + 7). Consent must be free, specific, informed, unambiguous.

fields.label: Retention Period (Years)
fields.description: Default retention used for Data Consent.expires_on and for Data Retention Rule when this purpose is selected. Overrides HR Settings dpdp_data_retention_years if set.

fields.label: Requires Explicit Consent
fields.description: When ON, a Data Consent record must exist before processing. When OFF (e.g., Statutory Obligation), processing is permitted under the lawful basis without consent.

fields.label: Data Categories Covered
fields.description: What fields/categories of personal data this purpose covers. Comma-separated or markdown list. Example: pan_number, bank_ac_no, ifsc_code, aadhaar_last_4

fields.label: Withdrawal Consequences
fields.description: What happens if the employee withdraws this consent. Shown in the consent withdrawal flow. Example: 'Salary payments will be delayed until alternative payout details are provided.'

fields.label: Notice Template (Jinja2 / Markdown)
fields.description: Markdown + Jinja2 template shown to the employee at consent capture. Available variables: {{ employee_name }}, {{ company }}, {{ purpose_name }}. Snapshotted into Data Consent.notice_shown_html so the exact text seen is preserved.
